name: Mermaid Live Editor
summary: Edit Mermaid diagrams with a live preview, then copy SVG or a self-contained embed HTML page.
description: Write Mermaid source for flowcharts, sequence diagrams, ER diagrams, Gantt charts, and more. Preview updates in your browser, export SVG, or generate embeddable HTML that loads Mermaid from a CDN. Live preview uses a bundled Mermaid build so your diagram never leaves the device.

faqs.question: Is my diagram uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. The live preview renders with Mermaid bundled in this page. Nothing is sent to a server.

faqs.question: What does Embed HTML do?
faqs.answer: It builds a self-contained HTML file with your diagram. When opened elsewhere, that page loads Mermaid from jsDelivr to render — useful for docs sites or sharing a static file.

faqs.question: Which diagram types work?
faqs.answer: Common Mermaid types: flowchart, sequence, class, ER, Gantt, pie, state, and others supported by Mermaid 11. Invalid syntax shows an error in the preview pane.
